name: Grand Prix Cycliste de Québec
story: After several attacks in the opening phase, a six-rider breakaway formed. Around halfway, the peloton increased the pace and brought the group back. Further attacks followed before Evenepoel, Ciccone and Charmig escaped from a reduced favourites’ group. Charmig was dropped on the final climb, after which Evenepoel beat Ciccone in a two-up sprint.
